summary: The opencode runtime's permission prompt for implement-cli-bootstrap names only a raw capability and glob (external_directory ~/.local/bin/*), with no reference to the node, the plan step, or the write scope it collides with, and is auto-rejected without giving the operator a chance to answer before the node fails.
missingContext: which tool call triggered the request
why it was auto-rejected instead of surfaced to the operator queue
operatorImpact: The message is generic enough to apply to any opencode run touching any directory outside the workspace; it gives no actionable next step (for example, widen the write scope, or confirm the path is intentional) and is auto-rejected rather than routed to operator/requests/, so the operator never even gets a chance to decide.
